# Copilot instructions

Follow the root `AGENTS.md` and `agent/design-contract.md` for all UI work. Neo-Brutalism is the primary system. Use Retro Pixel Art, Typography, Claymorphism, and Glassmorphism only as purposeful supporting accents, in that order of preference. Reuse the design tokens, preserve accessibility, and run `python3 scripts/validate.py` before finishing.
